title: Normalize inventory field names/units at one boundary; honor legitimate zero values
summary: All foundation-inventory normalization converges on one module, src/components/masterInventory/inventoryNormalization.js. Six identical strict-number parser copies, five draft-input copies, and the concrete-supplier field adapter were removed from calculators, write surfaces, and panels; every consumer now imports the same kernels. Field-name and unit canonicalization (brick_* → wall_unit_*, forming → forming_material, legacy pole_stock_length_inches → pole_stock_length_ft) runs once per row at the two ingress points: calcProject's inventory parameter and FoundationEstimator's setInventory. Authored rows are never mutated; normalization fills canonical fields on a calculation copy, and an explicitly authored canonical value (including null) always wins over a legacy alias.

boundaryContract.inventoryFiniteNumber: Finite signed number. String must match strict decimal grammar; number-typed inputs need only be finite. (was inputNumber, wallCapInputNumber)
boundaryContract.inventoryNonnegativeNumber: Catalog/customer price basis — finite, nonnegative. Explicit 0 is a legitimate free price. Blank/malformed/negative/non-finite → null (unavailable), never 0, never guessed. (was supplierPriceNumber, equipmentPriceNumber, wallPriceNumber, polePriceNumber, cabinetPriceNumber, landscapePriceNumber)
boundaryContract.inventoryPositiveNumber: Dimension/duration/quantity basis — finite, positive; accepts unsigned exponent strings matching the prior dimension parsers. (was wallDimensionNumber, poleDimensionNumber, equipmentPositiveNumber, cabinetQuantityNumber, landscapeCellSizeNumber)
boundaryContract.inventoryNonnegativeMeasurement: Measurement basis — finite, nonnegative with exponent strings; depth-in-ground may legitimately be 0. (was poleOffsetNumber)
boundaryContract.inventoryIsPositiveWhole: Positive whole-number predicate — safe integer > 0; string must be written as a whole number. (was positiveWholeNumber)
boundaryContract.inventorySettingValue: Explicit-0-respecting pick: recorded 0 wins; absent/blank/falsy keeps the ported default. (was wallSettingValue, poleSettingValue, calcItemCost getSetting pick)
boundaryContract.inventorySettingNumber: Setting composed onto the nonnegative price basis. (was wallSettingNumber, poleSettingNumber, foundationSettingNumber)
boundaryContract.inventoryPositiveSettingNumber: Setting composed onto the positive basis — for values the math divides by. (was wallPositiveSettingNumber, polePositiveSettingNumber)
boundaryContract.inventoryNumberInput: Catalog write-draft: blank → null ('not cataloged'), numeric → Number, malformed → verbatim for validation to report. Never partial-parses, never mints 0. (was catalogNumberInput ×4, FoundationItemCard nullSet, InventoryFormModal number coerce, MasterEquipmentTab/MasterSuppliesTab parseFloat||0 inputs)
boundaryContract.inventoryDraftInput: Project-entry draft: '' stays '' (authored empty state), numeric → Number, malformed → verbatim. (was equipmentInputValue, heightInput ×2)
boundaryContract.normalizeFoundationInventoryRow: Per-row canonicalization on a calculation copy: FOUNDATION_FIELD_ALIASES fills wall_unit_* from brick_* only when the canonical key is absent; FOUNDATION_MATERIAL_TYPE_ALIASES maps forming → forming_material; pole_stock_length_inches ÷ 12 → pole_stock_length_ft only when the canonical feet field is absent and the inch value parses positive. Authored fields preserved verbatim.
boundaryContract.normalizeFoundationInventoryRows: Array entry point (calcProject ingress + FoundationEstimator setInventory). Idempotent; non-array passes through.
boundaryContract.normalizeConcreteSupplier: LaborServiceInventory → FoundationInventory concrete_service shape, moved verbatim from legacyFoundationCalc (re-exported there). Mix/admixture/small-load/fuel fields keep null for 'not authored'; ported `|| 0` defaults retained for default_rate/minimum fields.

consumerMap.calc-ingress: calcProject(project, rawInventory) wraps inventory once via normalizeFoundationInventoryRows; normalized copies feed calcItem/legacyCalcItemCost, calcWalls, calcPoles, calcWallCaps, calcEquipmentPricing, calcConcreteDelivery, foundationAssemblyCatalogIssues, foundationConstructionWarnings.
consumerMap.page-ingress: FoundationEstimator setInventory wraps the combined FoundationInventory + normalizeConcreteSupplier(LaborServiceInventory) rows at both load sites — catalog memo, FoundationEquipmentTab, FoundationBOM and other tab props see the same canonical rows calcProject prices on.
consumerMap.calculators: wallCalculator, poleCalculator, wallCapCalculator, landscapeMaterials, foundationInputValidation, foundationCalc, legacyFoundationCalc import boundary kernels under their historical local names (wallPriceNumber etc.) — no ported math changed.
consumerMap.re-exports: legacyFoundationCalc re-exports normalizeConcreteSupplier (FoundationEstimator keeps its import path); wallCapCalculator re-exports wallCapInputNumber (FoundationWallCapsPanel keeps its import path).
consumerMap.write-surfaces: FoundationInventory, EquipmentInventoryTab, WallCapsInventoryTab, FoundationMaterialDialog (catalogNumberInput), FoundationItemCard (nullSet override draft), InventoryFormModal number coerce, MasterEquipmentTab cost_per_day/week/month + delivery fields, MasterSuppliesTab foundation cost_per_unit → inventoryNumberInput.
consumerMap.project-drafts: FoundationEquipmentTab equipmentInputValue, FoundationWallsPanel + FoundationPolesPanel heightInput → inventoryDraftInput.

fieldAliasFixtures: authored canonical null wins over legacy
realSurface: calcWalls: raw brick_stone row → wall_unit_*_unavailable hold; normalized → priced materialCost
calcProject: raw legacy inventory prices walls at ingress without caller normalization
calcProject: canonical rows produce identical totals normalized or not (idempotent double-normalization)

deliberateNonChanges: Ported calculator-internal math unchanged — legacyFoundationCalc item-dimension parseFloat(...) || 0 sites, poleCalculator/wallCalculator parseFloat(settingValue(...)) settings reads, FoundationItemCard numSet dimension drafts: these are project-input formula internals gated by the check side, not inventory-catalog normalization. Zero strict-regex copies remain outside the boundary.

Display-formatting parseFloat sites (FoundationInventory list rows, EquipmentInventoryTab/WallCapsInventoryTab price badges, MasterSuppliesTab cost_display) — render-only guards, no stored normalization.

Form-init `|| 0` presets (MasterEquipmentTab/MasterSuppliesTab edit-form initializers, EquipmentInventoryTab openAdd cost fields, FoundationInventory brick default 0.75): authored defaults for new/edited forms — preserved to avoid changing stored values for untouched rows; flagged as a follow-up remainder if admin wants stored nulls to display blank on open.

Non-CMP surfaces: importMappers cleanNum/toInches (sign-parts/substrate/dimensional-letter imports), legacyInventoryMigrator (labor_service[non-concrete]/sign_parts_supplies/substrate targets), MasterEquipmentTab spec fields (mpg, heights, idle_running_cost_per_hour — not consumed by foundation math), MasterSuppliesTab channel-letter cost fields.
partSync reads pole_stock_length_ft off entity rows directly (estimator builder BOM path, not the CMP calc path); unchanged.
foundationFieldSchema.js untouched — stays the field-definition source; inventoryNormalization.js owns runtime canonicalization rather than extending the schema contract.
behaviorDeltas: FoundationItemCard nullSet: whitespace-only draft now clears to null (remote minted Number(' ')=0 — a fabricated free override).
InventoryFormModal number fields: malformed drafts persist verbatim for validation to report (remote partial-parsed '12abc'→12, minted NaN for 'abc').
MasterEquipmentTab catalog cost fields + delivery, MasterSuppliesTab foundation cost_per_unit: blank → null 'not cataloged' and malformed → verbatim (remote minted 0 via parseFloat||0).

Legacy rows become priceable at ingress instead of held unavailable: brick_stone rows fill wall_unit_* from brick_*; 'forming' rows count as forming_material; pole_stock_length_inches rows convert to canonical feet.
calcProject parameter renamed inventory → rawInventory internally (normalized copy bound to `inventory`); signature and return contract unchanged.
